# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 29 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Oil of Mercy Is Promised for the Future

---

**1** Michael said to Seth: 'The oil of mercy will not come to you now. Many generations must pass before the Son of God comes.'

**2** 'But when he comes, he will raise all the righteous and give them the oil of mercy for eternal life.'

**3** Seth took these words to heart and went back to tell his father Adam.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
